- Validate inputs: ensure both lists are non-null, of equal length; decide behavior for non-integers (convert or raise), and handle empty lists by returning an empty list.
- Iterate over paired elements of game and guess; for each index, compute 0 if values are equal, otherwise compute abs(game[i] - guess[i]).
- Collect and return the list of computed differences, preserving order and length equal to inputs.
